message:
This PR updates the cron schedule for the "Connectors up-to-date" workflow to run at a more convenient time for the team.

## Changes Made

Changed the schedule in `.github/workflows/connectors_up_to_date.yml`:
- **Before**: `"0 10 * * 2"` - Every Tuesday at 10:00 UTC (3:00 AM PDT / 2:00 AM PST)
- **After**: `"0 3 * * 2"` - Every Tuesday at 03:00 UTC (8:00 PM PDT / 7:00 PM PST Monday evening)

## Rationale

Running the connectors up-to-date workflow at 8 PM Pacific on Monday evening instead of 3 AM Pacific on Tuesday morning provides several benefits:
1. Better alignment with working hours for monitoring and troubleshooting
2. Results are available first thing Tuesday morning
3. Reduces the likelihood of issues going unnoticed overnight

The workflow functionality remains unchanged - only the execution time has been adjusted to be more team-friendly while maintaining the same weekly cadence.

## Fix Applied

Initial implementation had incorrect timezone calculation. Fixed to properly target Monday evening Pacific time by scheduling for Tuesday 03:00 UTC instead of Monday 03:00 UTC.
